# `liber:camera-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:camera-device` package (`camera-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem camera devices - the provider contract a `camera` publication serves to CameraService.  A PROVIDER NORMALIZES AND WRITES; THE SERVICE DECIDES. The USB Video class module, and the in-guest fixture before it, turn their descriptors into these bounded formats with the staged normalizer, select what they are asked for, and write assembled frames into the buffers they were given. Which camera a client may use, whether what the provider selected is what was asked, and which buffer belongs to whom are CameraService's.  A BUFFER IS WRITTEN ONLY WHILE QUEUED. `queue` hands one buffer's write permission to the provider under a lease; a completion hands it back under the same lease; `stop` is answered only when every buffer the provider held has been given back and every mapping of it released.

### interface `camera-fixture`

The in-guest camera fixture's control endpoint. DEVELOPMENT ONLY: it exists on a development fixture bound to a QEMU test device, reached through PermissionManager in a development build for a probe whose policy row grants `fixture-control`.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `drop-device` | `drop-device(count: u32) -> result<unit, error>` | Lose the next `count` frames in the device, definitely observed. |
| 2 | `gap` | `gap() -> result<unit, error>` | Lose frames the device cannot count. |
| 3 | `timing` | `timing(on: bool) -> result<unit, error>` | Deliver device timing with frames, or none at all. |
| 4 | `reset-clock` | `reset-clock() -> result<unit, error>` | Reset the device clock: a new reset generation. |
| 5 | `delay-stop` | `delay-stop(delay-ms: u32) -> result<unit, error>` | Hold the next stop's answer for `delay-ms`; zero never answers it. |
| 6 | `withdraw` | `withdraw() -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 7 | `republish` | `republish() -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 8 | `stats` | `stats() -> result<camera-fixture-stats, error>` |  |
